name: skills-studio
description: Local Codex skill manager with availability checks, context estimates and a Markdown editor.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Codex skills, availability, sources and reviews
interface.longDescription: Browse personal, project and plugin skills with Codex availability, original paths and registrations. Check Git sources and record content reviews with evidence. Estimate catalogue context, edit Markdown with VIEW / EDIT / DIFF, and discuss each skill in a separate chat. Personal skill availability controls keep files in place. Data stays local; source updates are never installed automatically. English by default, with a saved English/Russian interface switch.
